2.260.2
MapLegend.ActionInfo
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapLegend.ActionInfo element specifies a set of actions for a MapLegend in a Map. This
element is optional and is of type ActionInfo.
Following is the parent element of the MapLegend.ActionInfo element.
Parent elements
MapLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapLegend.ActionInfo element.
 <xsd:element name="ActionInfo" type="ActionInfoType" minOccurs="0" />
